verses.t: Kalata iyi yachokera kwa Paulo, kapolo wa Mulungu ndi mtumwi wa Yesu Khristu. Nditumizidwa kulalikira chikhulupiriro kwa osankhidwa ndi Mulungu ndi kuphunzitsa choonadi chimene chimawaonetsera mmene angakhale ndi moyo wopembedza Mulungu.
Choonadi ichi chimawapatsa chiyembekezo cha moyo wosatha, umene Mulungu, amene saname, analonjeza asanalenga dziko.
Tsopano pa nthawi yake waulukira uthenga wake, umene tilalikira kwa aliyense. Nditumizidwa mwa lamulo la Mulungu Mpulumutsi wathu kuchita ntchito imeneyi.
Ndikulemba kwa Tito, mwana wanga weniweni m'chikhulupiriro chimene tigawana nacho. Chisomo ndi mtendere zichokere kwa Mulungu Atate ndi Khristu Yesu Mpulumutsi wathu.
Ndinakusiya ku Karete kuti umalitse ntchito yathu kumeneko ndi kukhazikitsa akulu m'mzinda uliwonse, monga mmene ndinakuuza.
Mkulu ayenera kukhala wopanda cholakwa. Ayenera kukhala mkazi mmodzi, ana ake akhale okhulupirira, osatchulidwa kuti achita mwachiwawa kapena osamvera.

Mtsogoleri wa mpingo ndi woyang'anira nyumba ya Mulungu, choncho ayenera kukhala wopanda cholakwa. Asakhale wodzikuza kapena waukali; asakhale woledzera, ochita nkhanza, kapena wachokochoko wa ndalama.
M'malo mwake, akhale wokonda alendo, wokonda chabwino, wanzeru, wolungama, woyera, ndi wodziretsa.
Ayenera kukhulupirika pa uthenga wokhulupirirwa umene anaphunzitsidwa, kuti athe kulimbikitsa ena ndi maphunziro abwino ndi kuwaonetsa otsutsa kuphonyeka kwawo.
Pakuti pali ambiri osamvera amene amayankhula zopanda phindu ndi kupusitsa anthu. Izi zimawonekera makamaka mwa iwo amene akukakamiza kudulwa.
Ayenera kumetsedwa pakamwa, chifukwa akatembenula mabanja onse mwa maphunziro achinyengo. Ndipo achita izi chifukwa cha ndalama.
Mneneri wawo mwini, mmodzi mwa Karete, anati za iwo, 'Akarete ndi anama nthawi yonse, nyama zokhala nkhanza, ndi anthu oleta ndi achipere.'
Ichi ndi choona. Choncho awadzudzule mwamphamvu kuti akhale olimba m'chikhulupiriro.
Asiye kusamalira nthano za aYuda ndi malamulo a anthu amene atapatuka ku choonadi.
Chilichonse ndi choyera kwa amene ali ndi mtima woyera. Koma kwa oipa ndi osakhulupirira, palibe chiyera, chifukwa maganizo awo ndi chikumbu mtima chawo zionongeka.
Akunena kuti amudziwa Mulungu, koma amukanira mwa khalidwe lawo. Ndi oyikitsa, osamvera, ndi opanda pake pa ntchito yabwino iliyonse.
Koma iwe, Tito, lalikira khalidwe limene limayenera maphunziro abwino.
Phunzitsa amuna achikulire kudziretsa, kuyenerera ulemu, ndi kukhala anzeru. Akhale ndi chikhulupiriro cholimba, chikondi, ndi kupirira.
Mwanjira yomweyo, phunzitsa akazi achikulire kukhala m'khalidwe loyenera Mulungu. Asamanene zoipa za anthu kapena akapoledzera. M'malo mwake, aphunzitse ena chabwino.
Aphunzitse akazi achichepere kukonda akamuna awo ndi ana awo,
kukhala anzeru ndi oyera, nagwira ntchito za nyumba zawo, ndi kuchita zabwino, ndi kugonjera akamuna awo. Motero Mawu a Mulungu sanyozedwe.
Mwanjira yomweyo, limbikitsa amuna achichepere kukhala anzeru.
Iwe mwini ukhale chitsanzo cha ntchito zabwino m'chilichonse. Pa maphunziro ako, onetsa uyeru ndi kulemekezeka.
Phunzitsa choonadi kuti maphunziro ako asatsutside. Motero adani athu adzachita manyazi, alibe choipa chinanena za ife.
Akapolo amvere abwana awo m'chilichonse ndi kuyesetsa kukondweretsa. Asamayankhule mwakutsutsa.
Asamabe, koma aonetse kuti ndi okhulupirika m'chilichonse. Motero adzayerekeza maphunziro a Mulungu Mpulumutsi wathu m'njira iliyonse.
Pakuti chisomo cha Mulungu chaulukira, chikubweretsa chipulumutso kwa anthu onse.
Chimaphunzitsa ife kusiya moyo wopanda Mulungu ndi zosangalatsa za dziko. Tikhale m'dziko lino ndi nzeru, kulungama, ndi kudzipereka kwa Mulungu,
tikudikira ndi chiyembekezo tsiku lodabwitsa, kubwera kwa ulemerero wa Mulungu wamkulu ndi Mpulumutsi wathu Yesu Khristu.
Iye anadzipereka kuti atilombole ku machimo onse, natiyeretsa, natipanga anthu ake okha, odzipereka kwathunthu kuchita zabwino.
Phunzitsa izi ndi kulimbikitsa okhulupirira kuzichita. Uli ndi ulamuliro wokudzudzula pamene pakufunika, choncho usawalole aliyense kukunyoza.
Wakumbutseni okhulupirira kuti agonjere boma ndi akuluakulu ake. Akhale omvera, okonzeka nthawi yonse kuchita chabwino.
Asamanene zoipa za aliyense kapena kukangana. M'malo mwake, akhale ofatsa ndi owonetsa odzichepetsa kwa aliyense.
Pakuti kale ife tinali opusa, osamvera, tasokera, akapolo a zofuna zambiri ndi zosangalatsa. Tinakhala ndi chidani ndi nsanje, tinali oyikitsa, ndipo timadana wina ndi m'modzi.
Koma Mulungu Mpulumutsi wathu ataululira kukoma kwake ndi chikondi chake kwa anthu,
anatipulumutsa, osati chifukwa cha ntchito zabwino zimene tinachita, koma chifukwa cha chifundo chake. Anatisambitsa kuti tikhale atsopano, napatsa moyo watsopano mwa Mzimu Woyera.
Anathira Mzimu wake mwachifundo mwa Yesu Khristu Mpulumutsi wathu.
Choncho ndi chisomo chake tinalungamitsidwa, ndipo tili ndi chiyembekezo cholimba cha kulandira moyo wosatha.
Ichi ndi mawu okhulupirika, ndipo ndikukomba muzikakamize maphunziro amenewo kuti onse amene akhulupirira Mulungu adzipereke kuchita zabwino. Izi ndi zabwino ndipo zithandiza onse.
Siya mikangano yopusa pa mzera wa makolo ndi nkhondo za malamulo a Mose. Izi ndi zopanda phindu ndi zopanda pake.
Ngati wina akubweretsa zigawano, mupereke mlangizo woyamba ndi wachiwiri. Pambuyo pa ichi, usagwetse nawo.
Ukudziwa kuti munthu wotere atapatuka ku choonadi, ndipo machimo ake mwini amuweruza.
Ndidzatumiza Artemasi kapena Tikikos kwa iwe. Mmodzi wa iwo atafika, yesa kubwera kwa ine ku Nikopoli, pakuti ndasankha kukhala kumeneko pa chilimwe.
Thandiza kwathunthu Zenasi katswiri wa malamulo ndi Apolos pa ulendo wawo. Onetsa kuti alibe china chosowa.
Anthu athu aphunzire kuchita zabwino kukwaniritsa zosowa za anthu; motero sadzikhala opanda phindu.
Aliyense ali ndi ine akupereka moni. Pereka moni kwa okhulupirira onse amene amatikondera. Chisomo cha Mulungu chikhale ndi inu nonse.
